title: rest: a cached GET /meta/object/:name that carries disabledActions is never answered 304 — fold the switched-off names into the ETag so object reads revalidate again
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V

Filing gate: ② a cost the contract review escalated to the maintainer on PR #27964 (#27842), triage record 6515936468 ③ "The 304 trade on objects". The maintainer approved #27964 as built (2026-10-30T10:29Z) and asked that 304s on object reads be won back by a separate card. This is that card. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 · `marchtian` · session `session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade and no lane: triage sets both (the code is `packages/rest`, with a possible touch in `packages/metadata-protocol`).
Reader: the lane triage assigns; one small PR.
Dedupe (open AND closed): semantic search "object metadata read ETag 304 disabledActions switched-off actions fingerprint cached GET meta object" → 7 hits. #27842 is the card that adds the key; #16525 is the organization-scope fold, closed; #25783 is metadata read CPU, closed. None folds the activation projection into the validator. **New.**
reach: read in code at PR #27964 head `b3d92fee`, not driven through a public door. Every console that opens an object on a deployment where the activation ledger is attached, which is the default: `PlatformObjectsPlugin` registers `sys_metadata_activation`, and `ObjectQLPlugin` attaches the ledger on every such boot.

## What the code does after #27964

`GET /api/v1/meta/object/:name` through the cached door serves `disabledActions` beside the item. The key is read live on every call and kept out of the ETag, so a read that carries it is answered `200` with the full body and never `304 Not Modified` (the docblocks on `GetMetaItemResponseSchema` and `GetMetaItemCachedResponseSchema` say so). On a default deployment that means every cached object read: objects are the console's hottest metadata read, so revalidation stops saving anything there.

## Wanted

- Fold the object's switched-off action names into the REST validator the way visibility, runtime-view, intake and audience fingerprints already are (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts`, the nested `foldVisibilityFingerprintIntoEtag` calls). Then an unchanged object with an unchanged switch set answers `304` again, and an administrator's switch under Setup › Packaged automation moves the ETag.
- The fold uses the same per-object answer the response carries (the names in `item.actions` that the projection switches off), so the validator describes the representation actually served (the #16525 lesson). Absent versus `[]` must fold differently.
- Pins: a `304` on a repeat read with no switch change; a `200` with a new ETag after a switch flips; the list read (`GET /meta/object`) if its cached door shares the rule.
- Correct the two docblocks' "never answered 304" sentence in the same PR. That is a published schema docblock, so it owes a contract review.

**Clause-②:** `no` (the accept set and the response shape do not change; only the validator does). **Metadata-protocol:** `none`. Lands after PR #27964.
